task_execution_commands_updated_at, task_execution_commands.completed_at AS task_execution_commands_completed_at FROM task_execution_commands JOIN tasks ON tasks.id = task_execution_commands.task_id WHERE task_execution_commands.status IN (?, ?) AND (task_execution_commands.retry_available_at IS NULL OR task_execution_commands.retry_available_at <= ?) AND (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_tickets JOIN task_admission_buckets ON task_admission_buckets."key" = task_admission_tickets.bucket_key WHERE task_admission_tickets.command_id = task_execution_commands.id AND (task_admission_tickets.owner_attempt_id IS NULL OR tasks.lease_attempt_id IS NULL OR task_admission_tickets.owner_attempt_id != tasks.lease_attempt_id OR task_admission_tickets.runner_id != tasks.runner_id) AND ((SELECT count(distinct(task_admission_tickets_1.task_id)) AS count_1 FROM task_admission_tickets AS task_admission_tickets_1 JOIN tasks AS tasks_1 ON tasks_1.id = task_admission_tickets_1.task_id WHERE task_admission_tickets_1.bucket_key = task_admission_tickets.bucket_key AND task_admission_tickets_1.task_id != tasks.id AND task_admission_tickets_1.owner_attempt_id = tasks_1.lease_attempt_id AND task_admission_tickets_1.runner_id = tasks_1.runner_id) >= task_admission_buckets.capacity OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_tickets AS task_admission_tickets_2 JOIN task_execution_commands AS task_execution_commands_1 ON task_execution_commands_1.id = task_admission_tickets_2.command_id JOIN tasks AS tasks_2 ON tasks_2.id = task_admission_tickets_2.task_id WHERE task_admission_tickets_2.bucket_key = task_admission_tickets.bucket_key AND task_admission_tickets_2.command_id < task_admission_tickets.command_id AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks AS tasks_3 WHERE tasks_3.id = task_admission_tickets_2.task_id AND tasks_3.lease_attempt_id = task_admission_tickets_2.owner_attempt_id AND tasks_3.runner_id = task_admission_tickets_2.runner_id)) AND (task_execution_commands_1.status NOT IN (?, ?)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_execution_commands AS task_execution_commands_2 WHERE task_execution_commands_2.task_id = task_execution_commands_1.task_id AND task_execution_commands_2.id < task_execution_commands_1.id AND (task_execution_commands_2.status NOT IN (?, ?)))) AND NOT (task_execution_commands_1.kind = ? AND tasks_2.status = ? AND tasks_2.control_state = ? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_tickets AS task_admission_tickets_3 WHERE task_admission_tickets_3.task_id = tasks_2.id AND task_admission_tickets_3.runner_id = tasks_2.runner_id AND task_admission_tickets_3.owner_attempt_id = tasks_2.lease_attempt_id))))) OR NOT (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_pacing WHERE task_admission_pacing.bucket_key = task_admission_tickets.bucket_key AND task_admission_pacing.next_start_at - (task_admission_pacing.burst - ?) * task_admission_pacing.interval_seconds > ((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400.0))))))) OR task_execution_commands.kind = ? AND tasks.status = ? AND tasks.control_state = ? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_tickets AS task_admission_tickets_4 WHERE task_admission_tickets_4.task_id = tasks.id AND task_admission_tickets_4.runner_id = tasks.runner_id AND task_admission_tickets_4.owner_attempt_id = tasks.lease_attempt_id))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_execution_commands AS task_execution_commands_3 WHERE task_execution_commands_3.task_id = task_execution_commands.task_id AND task_execution_commands_3.id < task_execution_commands.id AND (task_execution_commands_3.status NOT IN (?, ?)) AND NOT (task_execution_commands.kind IN (?, ?) AND task_execution_commands_3.status = ? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_admission_tickets WHERE task_admission_tickets.command_id = task_execution_commands_3.id AND task_admission_tickets.owner_attempt_id IS NULL))))) AND (tasks.runner_id = ? OR tasks.runner_id IS NULL OR tasks.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR tasks.lease_expires_at < ?) AND task_execution_commands.id = ? ORDER BY task_execution_commands.id ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
UPDATE tasks SET updated_at=tasks.updated_at WHERE tasks.id = ? AND tasks.runner_id = ? AND tasks.lease_attempt_id = ? RETURNING id
